subject: HelioPay VM closure ledger + ongoing scan cadence confirmation
messages:
From: Jamie Liu <jamie@heliopay.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: HelioPay Security <security@heliopay.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: consolidated VM closure ledger + cadence for SIG

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for walking us through the platform yesterday. As part of our SIG submission we need a single artefact that does two things: 1) shows the recent vulnerability closures tied to CVE IDs and remediation owners; and 2) confirms your ongoing authenticated scan cadence and SLA commitments for CVE remediation (critical/high/medium).

Specifically HelioPay is asking for:
- A closure ledger for the last 90 days with dates, affected component, CVE, remediation summary and evidence reference (scan logs, PR/patch link).
- Confirmation of cadence (weekly authenticated scans, monthly full external + internal scans) and expected SLA windows (eg: critical: 48 hours, high: 7 days, medium: 30/90 days) and how exceptions are handled.
- Any compensating controls where a longer remediation window is required.

Can you provide a single package we can upload into the SIG portal by EOD Tuesday?

Thanks,
Jamie
Security Program Manager
HelioPay
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Jamie Liu <jamie@heliopay.com>, HelioPay Security <security@heliopay.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated VM closure ledger + cadence for SIG

Jamie — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a single evidence package (heliopay-vm-evidence-20261018.zip) that contains:
- closure-ledger.csv (90d export: CVE, component, first_seen, remediation_ticket, PR/commit, closure_date, owner)
- scan-artefacts/ (authenticated scan reports + signed scan hashes)
- SLA-matrix.pdf (our default remediation windows + escalation path)
- exceptions.md (current exceptions and compensating controls)

Quick summary inline:
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated scans against customer-configured VPC peering endpoints (internal), monthly full stack authenticated scans (internal) and monthly external unauthenticated surface scans.
- SLA windows (standard): critical: 48 hours from triage to mitigated/workaround; high: 7 days; medium: 30 days; low: tracked on 90-day cadence. For enterprise contracts we can tighten the high/medium windows — see deal_id HL-2026-0047.
- Exceptions: where remediation would cause downtime we document planned mitigations (WAF rules, network isolation), tie to compensating controls (runtime filtering, WAF signatures, IDS rules) and set a monitored rollback plan.

Ben — can you confirm the ledger rows for the three CVEs we closed last week include the ticket links? Olga — please confirm the signed scan hashes were exported to the package before I send this to Jamie.

Rafael Mendes
Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- heliopay-vm-evidence-20261018.zip (zip, 3 files: closure-ledger.csv, SLA-matrix.pdf, exceptions.md)

Jamie — sending final confirmation and signed artifacts. We uploaded the package to the Drive link below and included signed scan hashes for the authenticated reports. Summary:
- Package uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HelioPayVMEvidence
- Closure ledger covers 2026-07-20 to 2026-10-18; 27 closures, 3 critical (all mitigated with hotfix), 9 high, 15 medium/low.
- Scan cadence is operational as described. Our operational playbook enforces a triage within 4 hours and a mitigation owner assigned within 8 hours for criticals.

If HelioPay needs additional evidentiary items (signed SBOMs for specific hosts, or kernel patch diffs) we can include those in an addendum. Rafael — please close the loop in the SIG portal once you upload, and I flagged DOCUSIGN-987654 for the SLA amendment agreement if they choose stricter windows.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
